conventions.spoken_strings: lowercase recognizer words, marks stripped; '{n}' is any spoken number
conventions.version_join: separator between family word and version ('' = attached, e.g. Qwen3, LFM2)
conventions.tier.join: separator before the tier word when it differs from a space
conventions.ambiguous: family/product word is also a common word or name; require a version/tier/model cue
conventions.version_words: Spoken versions render as digits: 'six point one' -> 6.1, 'four point oh' -> 4.0, 'four point two zero' -> 4.20 (keep trailing zeros as spoken). Two bare single digits after a versioned family word ('grok four seven') may be read as major.minor only for decimal-versioned families (GPT, Claude lines, Grok, GLM, Gemini); open question in NOTES.md.
conventions.sizes: '{n} b' -> {n}B, 'a {n} b' -> A{n}B, 'e {n} b' -> E{n}B; lowercase b only for gpt-oss
conventions.marks_inside_span: a recognizer mark between family word and version/tier ('GLM. 5.3') is dropped inside the span
conventions.extra_fields: api_id, known, notes, legacy, tier_alone_anchor are informative; the renderer may ignore them
